a01:s06 - Q4 FY2024 - non-GAAP scope and footnotes
Non-GAAP operating income excludes the signed amounts in the operating income reconciliation. Acquisition-related expense includes the Figma termination fee in the annual column. Loss contingency reversal relates to released liabilities. Lease charges relate to facility exits and disposal of lease assets. Non-GAAP measures supplement GAAP reporting and are reconciled separately from net income and diluted EPS.

## Data dictionary
Amounts, units and signed source adjustments retain the displayed source precision. months denotes the duration of the reporting period. period_end identifies actual economic periods. Future guidance periods keep fiscal labels where target tables supply no date. Section IDs locate source tables. No live data is required.

instruction: Assess Adobe's Q4 FY2024 execution against the guidance issued with its Q3 release. Report eps_difference (actual disclosed non-GAAP diluted EPS minus the upper guidance bound, USD per share), independently rebuilt adjusted_operating_income (USD million), adjusted_margin (percent), and margin_bridge (adjusted minus GAAP operating margin, basis points) for Q4. Assess: Q4 non-GAAP diluted EPS exceeded the upper end of that prior guidance.

answers.sql: SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3 AND measure='Non-GAAP diluted net income per share')-(SELECT high FROM guidance WHERE issue_date='2024-09-12' AND period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3 AND measure='Diluted EPS' AND basis='non-GAAP')

WITH x AS (SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3 AND measure='GAAP operating income') g,(SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3 AND measure='Total revenue') r,(SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3) a) SELECT g+a FROM x

WITH x AS (SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3 AND measure='GAAP operating income') g,(SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3 AND measure='Total revenue') r,(SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3) a) SELECT 100.0*(g+a)/r FROM x

WITH x AS (SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3 AND measure='GAAP operating income') g,(SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3 AND measure='Total revenue') r,(SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND months=3) a) SELECT 10000.0*a/r FROM x
